profile.name: Cy4gate S.p.A.
profile.summary: Cy4gate S.p.A. designs, develops, and produces technologies, products, systems, and services for cyber intelligence and cyber security needs for the companies, institutions, law enforcement agencies, and armed forces in Italy and internationally. The company offers CY4GARD, a forensic analysis and incident response solution; PronoCyber, a digital emergency response insurance platform against cyber-attacks and data breaches; QUIPO Enterprise, a decision intelligence software platform for improving the decision-making process; and VIP'S DIGITAL BODYGUARD to protect against online reputation attacks, privacy violations, cyber blackmailing, data leaks, covert unlawful monitoring, etc. It also operates CY4GATE Academy that provides recruiting, educational, and training programs to address cyber intelligence, cyber security engineering, cybersecurity incident response and recovery, and cybersecurity assessment needs. In addition, the company offers DSINT, an advanced intelligence analytics platform to collect, analyze, and transform heterogeneous data flows into strategic intelligence outcome; and C4I solutions for decision making in a range of military and law enforcement scenarios. Further, the company designs and develops network intelligence products to support law enforcement agencies and security agencies in conducting lawful interception operations; homeland security mobile assets; TACTICAL RTA to support the cyber team focusing on real-time threats; cyber electromagnetic attack systems and simulation models; and DIGILAB to perform digital activities for platform and system analysis, vulnerability management, and attack pattern engineering. Cy4gate S.p.A. was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Rome, Italy. Cy4gate S.p.A. operates as a subsidiary of Elettronica S.p.A.
profile.summary_fr: Cy4gate S.p.A. conçoit, développe et produit des technologies, des produits, des systèmes et des services pour les besoins des entreprises, des institutions, des forces de l'ordre et des forces armées en Italie et à l'étranger. La société propose CY4GARD, une solution d'analyse médico-légale et de réponse aux incidents; PronoCyber, une plate-forme d'assurance d'intervention d'urgence numérique contre les cyberattaques et les violations de données; QUIPO Enterprise, une plate-forme logicielle de renseignement décisionnel pour améliorer le processus décisionnel; et VIP'S DIGITAL BODYGUARD pour se protéger contre les attaques de réputation en ligne, les violations de la vie privée, le cyberchantement, les fuites de données, etc. Il exploite également CY4GATE Academy qui fournit des programmes de recrutement, d'éducation et de formation pour répondre aux besoins en matière de cyberintelligence, d'ingénierie de la cybersécurité, de réponse et de récupération des incidents de cybersécurité et d'évaluation de la cybersécurité.
